[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]NAKAMA[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Founded in Japan in 1925, Nakama gave its name to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama State[/color][/url][color=white], where its Japanese workers settled. In 2015 it tried to buy [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]NASC[/color][/url][color=white], kidnapped [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Sphere[/color][/url][color=white]’s CEO with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white]’s help, and lost the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]Second Corporate War[/color][/url][color=white]: its factories in Los Vales were destroyed, except one — the branch run by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF]Haruka Mori[/color][/url][color=white], which became [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white]. Nakama never forgave. In [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832555][color=#7FDBFF]World War III[/color][/url][color=white] it led the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832728][color=#7FDBFF]Pacific Union[/color][/url][color=white], demanded that Kizuna "come home", and put it on Japan’s list of enemies when [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF]Aiko Mori[/color][/url][color=white] refused.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]DREXLER INDUSTRIES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The engineering giant that dominated Europe in the 20th century and still does, weakened by World War III. Its most famous export to Los Vales was a person: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Viktor Hahn[/b][/color][/url][color=white], the former Drexler engineer who founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white] in 2024. Drexler’s Europe was dragged into the world war between the two blocs and came out poorer; it now buys Valian robots built on a design that started in its own labs.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]REDSTAR COMBINE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The arms and industrial conglomerate of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832727][color=#7FDBFF]Neo-Soviet bloc[/color][/url][color=white], heir of the old Soviet giant. In 2067 it armed the bloc that went to war with the Pacific Union over the rivers and fields of Central Asia. Its armies were among the biggest buyers of Valian metals from space, ArmaTech rifles and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white]’s [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Velocitas[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]LIBERTY ORDNANCE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]When the military rebuilt the United States after 2012, they gathered what was left of its arms industry into one state consortium. Liberty Ordnance supplied the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]New American Union[/color][/url][color=white]’s invasion in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF]Reunification War[/color][/url][color=white] of 2049, and lost to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white], ArmaTech and Automa. It has rebuilt its stockpiles every year since. Officially, the Union has never signed a peace with Los Vales.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]KAIYŌ LINES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A Japanese shipping company that runs the Pacific trade lane between the port of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] and the Pacific Union. During World War III it was the only Japanese company that never stopped working with Los Vales, because nobody, not even Nakama, could do without Valian metal. Its crews do not leave the port: Ferox, they say, is no place for sailors.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CANA VIVA[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A Brazilian bioenergy and seed company that turned the sugarcane fields of the south into fuel and the seeds of the Amazon into a business. During the droughts it sold Los Vales cane ethanol for its last combustion cars and open, unpatented seeds that compete with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Verdana[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Harvest Union[/color][/url][color=white]. The agricorps call it a smuggler. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]Black Seed[/color][/url][color=white] has never touched one of its fields.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]TIANLONG[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Chinese electronics and rare-earth giant was the world’s largest supplier of the metals inside every screen and every weapon — until World War III, when [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]BeDay Astral[/color][/url][color=white] began bringing them down from space. Tianlong lost the metals but kept the chips: by most estimates, half the processors inside the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna Lens[/color][/url][color=white] are made by Tianlong, which Kizuna prefers not to mention.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THAMES & CROWN[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A London house of insurance and banking older than the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832544][color=#7FDBFF]Blackstones[/color][/url][color=white]. It insures the insurers: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Sentinel Mutual[/color][/url][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Halo Response[/color][/url][color=white]’s fleet and every ship of Kaiyō Lines that enters the port of Ferox are reinsured in London. When the Republic went bankrupt in 2028, Thames & Crown was the only foreign creditor that did not try to collect. It prefers to wait.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]SERENE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A French pharmaceutical laboratory specialized in sleep medicine, and Europe’s answer to Zyx: pills for deep sleep [/color][color=white][i]without[/i][/color][color=white] dreams. Serene products were banned in Los Vales in 2038, the year of the great deregulation, after Zyx lobbied the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white]. They still arrive through the Smugglers’ Coves, and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Awake[/color][/url][color=white] buy them by the box.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]SAHEL SUN[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A Pan-African solar company that runs the panels across the Sahel and sells power from Dakar to the Cape. In the 2050s it offered to cover the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] desert in solar farms and sell the energy to Los Vales. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Portenova Corp[/color][/url][color=white] blocked the deal in the Cabinet. Sahel Sun stayed neutral in World War III and came out of it as the largest energy company on its continent.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]VAYU ORBITAL[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]An Indian space company whose satellites cover most of the planet, including the sky over Los Vales. BeDay Astral mines asteroids; Vayu watches and talks. Its satellite links are the only connections in Los Vales that pass neither through the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]W-Net[/color][/url][color=white] nor through any [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]C-Net[/color][/url][color=white] — which makes them very popular with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF]Neon Wire[/color][/url][color=white], and very unpopular with Bastion.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE WORLD AND LOS VALES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]For the foreign giants, Los Vales is a customer, a supplier and a rival at the same time. It sold weapons, robots, food and metal to every side of World War III and came out of it as the richest country in the world. Nobody abroad trusts it. Everybody buys from it.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE NAKAMA ACT (2018)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]After the Second Corporate War, in which Nakama took orders from Osaka on Valian soil, the Republic passed the [/color][color=white][b]Nakama Act[/b][/color][color=white]: no foreign company may sell, hire, own land or operate directly in Los Vales. Whoever wants to enter must found a Valian company with its headquarters in Los Vales, named after the parent company [/color][color=white][b]translated into English, followed by "of Los Vales"[/b][/color][color=white].[/color]

[color=white]The subsidiary is only half free: the parent may own at most 49%, half the board must be Valian citizens, and the parent may not give orders on security, war or the Cabinet. Foreigners may also buy shares of Valian companies, but only shares without a vote: the profit may leave the country, the orders may not. If Los Vales goes to war with the parent’s country, the Cabinet takes the subsidiary. Every credit of profit that leaves the country pays the [/color][color=white][b]Sovereignty Fee[/b][/color][color=white]. The Charter of 2028 kept the law as its Article XI.[/color]

[color=white]Today: [/color][color=white][b]Sky Dragon of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (Tianlong), [/color][color=white][b]Ocean Lines of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (Kaiyō Lines), [/color][color=white][b]Wind Orbital of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (Vayu Orbital), [/color][color=white][b]Turner Industries of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (Drexler), [/color][color=white][b]Living Cane of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (Cana Viva), [/color][color=white][b]Thames & Crown of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] and [/color][color=white][b]Red Star of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (RedStar Combine). [/color][color=white][b]Calm of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (Serene) was closed in 2038. Sahel Sun’s license was refused. Liberty Ordnance, of an enemy nation, may not have one. And Nakama’s request — [/color][color=white][i]Comrades of Los Vales[/i][/color][color=white] — has been denied every year since 2018.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=The rebel subsidiary][color=white]In the chip embargo of 2071, Beijing ordered Tianlong to stop selling to Los Vales. [/color][color=white][b]Sky Dragon of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] obeyed in public. In secret, citing the Nakama Act — the parent could not give orders on matters of the Cabinet — it kept one factory in Zyxtopia running for a single client: Kizuna, which had paid for it. For six months the rest of the country had no chips. The Kizuna Lens never stopped selling.[/color][/spoiler]

[table=plain][tr][td]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-why-invade/article-why-invade.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]A SMALL COUNTRY, A HUNGRY WORLD[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Los Vales has seven cities, no national army and neighbors who are starving. Every year someone asks why nobody takes it. The answer is not in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF]the Charter[/color][/url][color=white]. It is in the bank statements of the rest of the world.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]EVERYONE OWNS A PIECE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Los Vales is less a country than a free zone, and the world already profits from it. Under the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama[/color][/url][color=white] Act a foreigner may buy shares of the ten conglomerates, but only shares without a vote: they receive the profit and never give an order. Those shareholders live in Osaka, Lagos, Singapore and Zurich. Pension funds abroad hold Valian Debt Bonds. The factories of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832728][color=#7FDBFF]Pacific Union[/color][/url][color=white] run on [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]BeDay[/color][/url][color=white] metal. To invade Los Vales would be to bomb your own investments, and the people who own them would not allow it.[/color]

[color=white]There is a second trap. Every foreign company in Los Vales works through a Valian subsidiary, and on the first day of a war with its home country the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] takes it. Whoever invades loses its share of Los Vales before the first shot lands.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE ONES WHO TRIED[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]New American Union[/color][/url][color=white] is the exception: it owns nothing in Los Vales and has nothing to lose there. It tried in 2013 and lost to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white]. It tried again in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF][b]Reunification War[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b] of 2049[/b][/color][color=white] and lost again, to WM armor, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white] droids and an army of contractors paid by the hour. Since then it has built a wall to keep its own people in.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WHAT NOBODY CONFIRMS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Two things keep the generals of the world awake, and neither has ever been confirmed. The first is the bomb. WM once held the only nuclear arsenal of the West, and in 2022 the world learned that it had never been dismantled. Nobody knows what is left of it.[/color]

[color=white]The second is the sky. BeDay Astral has a station and a fleet in orbit, and a load of space metal dropped from orbit hits like a missile that no radar was built to stop. BeDay calls this "a misunderstanding of physics". Nobody laughs. And some say BeDay would not need to drop anything at all.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]
